events.region: Lower Treasure Valley; Upper Treasure Valley
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Heat Advisory, temperatures 98 to 103 degrees. For
the Wind Advisory, south winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 65 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Lower Treasure Valley and Upper Treasure Valley.

* WHEN...For the Heat Advisory, until 9 PM MDT this evening. For the
Wind Advisory, from 6 PM to 10 PM MDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result. Hot
temperatures may cause heat illnesses.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong gusts from the south and southwest will
create areas of blowing dust and visibility as low as one mile,
advancing northward through the Snake Basin, with greatest impacts
between 800 PM and 930 PM MDT.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Cumberland County in central North Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 545 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 247 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Fayetteville, Hope Mills, Eastover, Stedman, Vander, Cedar Creek,
Bushy Lake Natural Area and Bonnie Doone.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
